titulo: Factor of safety of dumps on a competent level foundation (Morgenstern–Price, Slide2), placed waste rock: median / 5th-percentile envelope
filas: Untested, degraded rock type E only
nota: Uniform dry face without benches; unit weight 17.2 kN/m³ (rock type E only: 15.7 kN/m³). Monte Carlo at 700 m with 600 envelope samples, each with its own search: model correlation 0 failures (lognormal reliability index 3.2); rock type E only 5 (index 2.3). 700 m, model correlation: without size shift 1.54 / 1.40; laboratory density with size shift (21 kN/m³) 1.74 / 1.38; laboratory density and size 1.74 / 1.59; size effect at its estimated mean 1.62 / 1.29; Weibull scaling 1.40 / 1.12; independent size shifts per rock type 1.55 / 1.35; tested samples taken as representative 1.51 / 1.22; quadratic form 1.49 / 1.19.
